_help: The Stock Media tab is built from this file. Edit the copy Dafin puts in your app data folder
(Stock Media tab -> Edit catalog) and press Reload; the built-in copy is never changed.
Every source has: id, name, kind (video | audio | lottie | image), and either
type 'static' + items[]              a fixed list of files, or
type 'api'    + search/browse/map    any JSON search API.
static item fields: title, url (direct file link), thumb (optional image), preview (optional
small video/audio for hover), tags, author, license, page (where it came from).
api: 'search' and 'browse' are URL templates. {query} {page} {perPage} {apiKey} are filled in.
'browse' is used while the search box is empty. 'headers' are sent with every request.
'items' is the path to the result array; 'map' says where each field lives in one result.
Paths use dots: 'videos.tiny.url'. A number picks an array element: 'video_files.0.link'.
'list{width<=1920}' picks the element with the largest width not above 1920;
'list{width>=480}' picks the smallest width not below 480.
Fields can be joined: 'user.name' or a literal in quotes, e.g. "'Pexels'".
Downloads go to a temporary folder that is deleted when Dafin closes. Media you used in a
project you saved is stored inside the .drift file, so it is never lost.
